user.title: Connect your MaxVapor account
user.description: Paste an API token from your MaxVapor dashboard. Generate one under Access tokens on a device's Data Logs page at dashboard.maxvapor.com.

error.invalid_auth: The dashboard rejected that token. Copy it again from the Data Logs page.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach dashboard.maxvapor.com. Check your connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: Your MaxVapor account is already set up.
